title: Tongue Rush
summary: Snap bugs from a moonlit lily pad, build a 12x multiplier and dodge wasps.
description: Pepe sits on a floating lily pad in the middle of a moonlit pond. Bugs cross the sky in rhythmic patterns: aim and snap the tongue to catch them. Golden fireflies raise the multiplier up to 12x, rainbow bugs start a slow-motion Frenzy with huge score boosts, and wasps break the multiplier and cost a life. Near-misses on wasps earn style bonuses. Three lives, endless rounds, instant restart, synthesized sound effects and chill pond music.
controls: Mouse to aim, click or Space to snap. WASD or arrow keys also aim. Touch: drag to aim, release or tap to snap. Gamepad: right stick aims, A snaps. Esc pauses, R restarts, M mutes.
